I get why people are skeptical because it’s anecdotal, but I’m from LA originally and started raving there back in 2007. 

Throughout the years I moved to and lived in Miami, New York and St. Maarten. I’ve partied in Toronto and Montreal as well. 

It’s not so much the geographical location but more the TYPE of parties. 

At big massives, I’m def on my game to make sure I don’t slip and get jacked. That’s the type of parties I entered the scene with, like EDC. 

As I got older, I started going to smaller and smaller parties and to more of a niche genre instead of big name DJs. 

You end up running into the same group of people and those people also travel to different cities for these parties. In the end, these smaller parties feel more intimate because you see familiar faces and everyone’s on the same page. I’m definitely more relaxed with worrying about getting being jacked at these kind of parties but best believe if I end up at a massive my mind switches back to the being-on-my-game mode.

MD here. 

I think you should get your cardiovascular function assessed by a doctor to see if you’re even healthy enough to exercise right now. From the sounds of it, it may be that your heart is not pumping well enough and that could actually make exercise dangerous. If walking doesn’t make you short of breath, start with that. 

Agree with some of the other’s advice of healthy diet. If you smoke, I would seriously consider quiting at the moment. 

Best of luck and I wish you a speedy recovery.

> All things considered it’s not as bad as most hard drugs considering it’s used as an anesthetic. 

MD here, that’s not at all a good way to look at it. Nitrous oxide is a neurotoxin (poison for your brain, spinal cord and nerves). Just because somethings used in the medical field, albeit anesthetic or medicine, does not mean it’s considered safe or safer than other narcotics. The people administering these drugs literally spent most of their lives studying to do so.

Agreed which is why I personally think all recreational drugs should be legalized, heavily mandated and regulated by the government for purity, quality control and safety and subsequently taxed. Funnel all the tax profit into drug education and rehabilitation. You’d eliminate the drug war/black market overnight as well. 

History’s already proven time and time again prohibition does not work.
